inlines.v: BEARD'ED, adjective berd'ed. Having a beard, as a man. Having parallel hairs or tufts of hair, as the leaves of plants. 1. Barbed or jagged, as an arrow. BEARD'ED, participle passive berd'ed. Taken by the beard; opposed to the face. BEARD'-GRASS, noun A plant, the Andropogon.
